Name: SHOP_LINEUP_PARAM
Description: Defines some shop-related settings for purchasable items. Made largely obsolete by EquipmentLineupParam.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: ID of the equipment for sale

Fields.Name: Sell Price Overwrite
Fields.Description: Selling price to overwrite (-1: Do not overwrite)

Fields.Name: Required Material ID
Fields.Description: Material ID required for purchase (-1: None)

Fields.Name: Quantity - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that holds the item's count.

Fields.Name: Sale Unlock - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that unlocks this item for sale.

Fields.Name: Sell Price (SAN)
Fields.Description: Sale price as a SAN value.
